name: Factorial Score Isomorphism
description: Replaced the explicit "lexicographically smallest" tie-breaker with a mathematical objective to maximize the sum of 1/i! for indices assigned to tier 1. Because 1/i! is strictly greater than the sum of 1/k! for all k > i, this objective mathematically uniquely selects the lexicographically smallest sequence. Models that pattern-match will attempt to calculate this score using floats (which underflow) or BigInts (which TLE), failing unless they logically deduce its equivalence to lexicographical order. Additionally, the edge condition was changed to an average of 1.5 to obfuscate the bipartite check.
